# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Friday, November 6, 2026

*Friday edition covering 5 November closes and overnight prints. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed gold-loan peer.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD closes; bids stood at 2.67x
The Tranche I public NCD closed on 5 Nov with the book at 2.67x the ₹200 crore base at 17:00 IST, up from 2.55x a day earlier. Retail was at 2.51x, HNI 3.79x, non-institutional 1.34x and institutional 0.02x.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: at 2.67x the book is about ₹534 crore against the ₹500 crore ceiling, so the full green shoe is covered once allotment is finalised on 9 Nov.
Source: [Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)


### Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
| Field | Value | As of |
|---|---|---|
| Status | Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; allotment 9 Nov, BSE listing 10 Nov ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)) | 2026-11-05 |
| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe), under a ₹4,000 crore shelf | 2026-11-05 |
| Rating | CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable | 2026-11-05 |
| Coupon | 8.56%–9.25% | 2026-11-05 |
| Bids | 2.67x at 17:00 IST (retail 2.51x, HNI 3.79x, NII 1.34x, institutional 0.02x) | 2026-11-05 |

### Muthoot Microfin Q2 PAT ₹110.8 crore; gold co-lending with Muthoot Fincorp at ₹453 crore
Muthoot Microfin, a Muthoot Fincorp subsidiary, reported Q2 FY27 PAT of ₹110.8 crore, up 262.9% YoY, on total income of ₹732.9 crore. Disbursements hit a record ₹2,900 crore and GLP rose 22% to ₹15,323 crore; the release says gold loans through referrals and co-lending with Muthoot Fincorp disbursed ₹453 crore in the quarter.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the subsidiary's rebound feeds the consolidated Q2 pack due 14 Nov, and the ₹453 crore co-lending line is a direct volume and fee read for Muthoot Fincorp's gold book.
Source: [NSE press release (Muthoot Microfin)](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/muthootmicrofin_05112026171622_MMLQ2FY27PressReleaseSD.pdf)

### RBI puts bank PSL draft Directions out for comment; 5% NBFC on-lending cap retained
RBI on 5 Nov published five draft Priority Sector Lending Directions for banks (commercial banks, SFBs, LABs, RRBs, UCBs), consolidating existing PSL rules. Comments are due by 26 Nov. ETBFSI reports the drafts retain the overall PSL targets and the 5% cap on eligible bank lending through NBFCs for on-lending.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the on-lending cap stays the binding constraint on how much PSL-eligible bank funding can reach gold and other NBFC books through the on-lending channel; no new headroom in this draft.
Source: [RBI press release](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63925)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

### Sensex and FinNifty surge on NCD's closing day
The Sensex rose 2.60% and Nifty Financial Services 3.99% on 5 Nov as the Tranche I book closed. Listed gold-loan peers also jumped: Muthoot Finance +4.77% to ₹2,839 and Manappuram +3.76% to ₹326.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a strong close for gold-lender paper on allotment eve helps secondary-market pricing once the NCDs list on 10 Nov.
Source: [NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_05112026.csv)

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Sensex up 2.60% to 79,310; Nifty Financial Services up 3.99%
The Sensex closed at 79,310.01 on 5 Nov, up 2,008.61 points (2.60%), and the Nifty 50 rose 2.40% to 24,536.60. Nifty Financial Services gained 3.99% to 26,600.45; Nifty Auto rose 4.14% to 27,601.75.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: non-bank lenders led the sixth straight up day, which supports the comparison set for listed NCD sentiment.
Source: [NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_05112026.csv)

### Peers: Bajaj Finance +7.65%, Shriram Finance +6.08%, Muthoot Finance +4.77%
On NSE, Bajaj Finance closed at ₹1,070.00 (+7.65%), Shriram Finance at ₹964.00 (+6.08%), Muthoot Finance at ₹2,839.00 (+4.77%), IIFL Finance at ₹604.50 (+4.55%), Manappuram at ₹326.00 (+3.76%) and Muthoot Microfin at ₹157.89 (+3.15%).
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: peer gold lenders and the subsidiary all finished higher on the day the NCD closed and Microfin reported.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_05112026.csv)

### FIIs buy a provisional ₹14,974.68 crore, largest day in over a year
Provisional exchange data show FIIs net bought ₹14,974.68 crore of Indian equities on 5 Nov, while DIIs net sold ₹10,444.54 crore. Moneycontrol says it was the biggest single-day FII buy in more than a year.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a foreign-flow turnaround supports equity-market conditions around the allotment and listing window; it does not change NCD allotment maths.
Source: [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/fiis-stage-biggest-single-day-buying-in-over-a-year-net-purchase-rs-14-975-crore-on-november-5-14071781.html)

### Rupee closes at 94.47; Brent settles at $98.29
BusinessLine reports the rupee closed at 94.47 per dollar on 5 Nov, up 17 paise from 94.64. Brent settled at $98.29 a barrel, up 3.88% on the day after a sharp midweek drop.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a firmer rupee and softer multi-day oil trend ease the inflation path the market is pricing into bank funding costs.
Source: [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/forex/rupee-closes-at-a-2-month-high-on-possibility-of-de-escalation-west-asia-war-softening-crude-weak-dollar/article71670743.ece)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### RBI drafts five bank-wise PSL Directions; comments by 26 Nov
RBI press release 2026-2027/1447 (5 Nov) puts draft PSL Directions for commercial banks, SFBs, LABs, RRBs and UCBs out for comment until 26 Nov. Full cards are in today's regulation report.
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63925)

### SEBI issues three market-structure circulars on 5 Nov; no NBFC lending instrument
SEBI's 5 Nov circulars cover the accredited-investor framework, net settlement of funds for mutual-fund cash-market trades, and currency-derivatives exposure limits. None changes NBFC lending rules. Full cards are in today's regulation report.
Source: [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

### Muthoot Microfin Q2 FY27: PAT ₹110.8 crore, NIM 12.5%, GNPA 3.38%
Beyond the headline PAT, Muthoot Microfin reported NIM up 50 bps QoQ to 12.5%, average cost of borrowing down to 9.93%, credit cost 2.6%, GNPA 3.38% (−123 bps YoY) and NNPA 1.05%. Non-JLG portfolio rose to 31% of GLP; CareEdge Global revised its outlook to Positive.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: better subsidiary earnings and funding cost feed the consolidated Q2 story and the group funding narrative.
Source: [NSE press release (Muthoot Microfin)](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/muthootmicrofin_05112026171622_MMLQ2FY27PressReleaseSD.pdf)

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

### CareEdge Global revises Muthoot Microfin outlook to Positive
Muthoot Microfin's Q2 release says CareEdge Global revised its outlook to Positive while reaffirming the BB- rating; CRISIL's earlier AA-/Stable long-term and A1+ CP ratings were restated in the same note.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a Positive outlook at the MFI subsidiary is a group-credit data point, not a change to Muthoot Fincorp's own NCD ratings.
Source: [NSE press release (Muthoot Microfin)](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/muthootmicrofin_05112026171622_MMLQ2FY27PressReleaseSD.pdf)

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

No significant developments today.

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

No significant developments today.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

No significant developments today beyond Muthoot Microfin's GNPA/NNPA figures above.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

No significant developments today.

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Friday: Auto finance & EV lending

### AMU Leasing's commercial-EV book reaches 14,000 customers across 10 states
AMU Leasing, an RBI-registered NBFC focused on commercial EVs, said it has about 14,000 customers across 10 states, with non-metro markets at 65% of disbursements, and plans to enter Rajasthan and Chhattisgarh. The portfolio covers e-2Ws, e-3Ws, passenger and commercial EVs plus battery solutions.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none direct. It shows specialist NBFCs still scaling EV books outside metros while gold lenders stay on collateralised products.
Source: [ET Auto](https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/commercial-vehicle/amu-expands-ev-financing-presence-across-10-states-acquires-14000-customers/135487563)

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Friday, 6 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

### [DRAFT] RBI consolidates Priority Sector Lending instructions into five bank-wise draft Directions
RBI on 5 Nov placed five draft Priority Sector Lending Directions on its website — one each for commercial banks, small finance banks, local area banks, regional rural banks and urban co-operative banks — and invited comments by 26 Nov 2026. The drafts consolidate existing PSL targets and classification rules; ETBFSI reports they retain the overall PSL targets and the 5% cap on eligible bank lending through NBFCs for on-lending.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no new NBFC Direction today, but the retained 5% on-lending cap is the ceiling that shapes how much PSL-eligible bank money can reach gold and other NBFC books through the on-lending channel.
Reference: Press Release 2026-2027/1447 · Addressed to: commercial banks, SFBs, LABs, RRBs, UCBs (draft Directions) · Issued: 5 Nov 2026 · Comments by: 26 Nov 2026
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63925)

### SEBI circulars on 5 Nov: accredited investors, MF net settlement, currency-derivatives limits
SEBI issued three circulars on 5 Nov: HO/19/34/11(6)2026-AFD-POD1/I/25244/2026 (accredited-investor framework), HO/24/13/(1)2026-IMD-POD-2/I/25242/2026 (net settlement of funds for mutual-fund cash-market trades), and HO/(561)2026-MRD-POD2/I/25177/2026 (currency-derivatives underlying-exposure limits). None is addressed to NBFCs as lenders.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none for lending or NCD disclosure. Listed only so the circulars list stays complete.
Source: [SEBI — accredited investors](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/nov-2026/review-of-the-framework-for-accredited-investors_105618.html)

### No new NBFC instrument from RBI notifications, IBBI, NHB or FIU-IND on 5 Nov
RBI's notification feed has nothing after FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB of 2 Nov. The Master Directions page shows no fresh "Updated as on" change for NBFC Directions beyond prior checks. IBBI and NHB pages returned no new NBFC circular dated 5 Nov in this morning's fetch.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no new compliance action from those channels today.
Source: [RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx)

---

cards.title: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD closes; bids stood at 2.67x
cards.summary: The Tranche I public NCD closed on 5 Nov with the book at 2.67x the ₹200 crore base at 17:00 IST, up from 2.55x a day earlier. Retail was at 2.51x, HNI 3.79x, non-institutional 1.34x and institutional 0.02x.
cards.impact: at 2.67x the book is about ₹534 crore against the ₹500 crore ceiling, so the full green shoe is covered once allotment is finalised on 9 Nov.

cards.title: Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
cards.summary: Field Value As of Status Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; allotment 9 Nov, BSE listing 10 Nov (Chittorgarh) 2026-11-05 Size ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe), under a ₹4,000 crore shelf 2026-11-05 Rating CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable 2026-11-05 Coupon 8.56%–9.25% 2026-11-05 Bids 2.67x at 17:00 IST (retail 2.51x, HNI 3.79x, NII 1.34x, institutional 0.02x) 2026-11-05

cards.title: Muthoot Microfin Q2 PAT ₹110.8 crore; gold co-lending with Muthoot Fincorp at ₹453 crore
cards.summary: Muthoot Microfin, a Muthoot Fincorp subsidiary, reported Q2 FY27 PAT of ₹110.8 crore, up 262.9% YoY, on total income of ₹732.9 crore. Disbursements hit a record ₹2,900 crore and GLP rose 22% to ₹15,323 crore; the release says gold loans through referrals and co-lending with Muthoot Fincorp disbursed ₹453 crore in the quarter.
cards.impact: the subsidiary's rebound feeds the consolidated Q2 pack due 14 Nov, and the ₹453 crore co-lending line is a direct volume and fee read for Muthoot Fincorp's gold book.

cards.title: RBI puts bank PSL draft Directions out for comment; 5% NBFC on-lending cap retained
cards.summary: RBI on 5 Nov published five draft Priority Sector Lending Directions for banks (commercial banks, SFBs, LABs, RRBs, UCBs), consolidating existing PSL rules. Comments are due by 26 Nov. ETBFSI reports the drafts retain the overall PSL targets and the 5% cap on eligible bank lending through NBFCs for on-lending.
cards.impact: the on-lending cap stays the binding constraint on how much PSL-eligible bank funding can reach gold and other NBFC books through the on-lending channel; no new headroom in this draft.

cards.title: Sensex and FinNifty surge on NCD's closing day
cards.summary: The Sensex rose 2.60% and Nifty Financial Services 3.99% on 5 Nov as the Tranche I book closed. Listed gold-loan peers also jumped: Muthoot Finance +4.77% to ₹2,839 and Manappuram +3.76% to ₹326.
cards.impact: a strong close for gold-lender paper on allotment eve helps secondary-market pricing once the NCDs list on 10 Nov.

cards.title: Sensex up 2.60% to 79,310; Nifty Financial Services up 3.99%
cards.summary: The Sensex closed at 79,310.01 on 5 Nov, up 2,008.61 points (2.60%), and the Nifty 50 rose 2.40% to 24,536.60. Nifty Financial Services gained 3.99% to 26,600.45; Nifty Auto rose 4.14% to 27,601.75.
cards.impact: non-bank lenders led the sixth straight up day, which supports the comparison set for listed NCD sentiment.

cards.title: Peers: Bajaj Finance +7.65%, Shriram Finance +6.08%, Muthoot Finance +4.77%
cards.summary: On NSE, Bajaj Finance closed at ₹1,070.00 (+7.65%), Shriram Finance at ₹964.00 (+6.08%), Muthoot Finance at ₹2,839.00 (+4.77%), IIFL Finance at ₹604.50 (+4.55%), Manappuram at ₹326.00 (+3.76%) and Muthoot Microfin at ₹157.89 (+3.15%). Source: NSE bhavcopy
cards.impact: peer gold lenders and the subsidiary all finished higher on the day the NCD closed and Microfin reported.

cards.title: FIIs buy a provisional ₹14,974.68 crore, largest day in over a year
cards.summary: Provisional exchange data show FIIs net bought ₹14,974.68 crore of Indian equities on 5 Nov, while DIIs net sold ₹10,444.54 crore. Moneycontrol says it was the biggest single-day FII buy in more than a year.
cards.impact: a foreign-flow turnaround supports equity-market conditions around the allotment and listing window; it does not change NCD allotment maths.

cards.title: Rupee closes at 94.47; Brent settles at $98.29
cards.summary: BusinessLine reports the rupee closed at 94.47 per dollar on 5 Nov, up 17 paise from 94.64. Brent settled at $98.29 a barrel, up 3.88% on the day after a sharp midweek drop.
cards.impact: a firmer rupee and softer multi-day oil trend ease the inflation path the market is pricing into bank funding costs.

cards.title: RBI drafts five bank-wise PSL Directions; comments by 26 Nov
cards.summary: RBI press release 2026-2027/1447 (5 Nov) puts draft PSL Directions for commercial banks, SFBs, LABs, RRBs and UCBs out for comment until 26 Nov. Full cards are in today's regulation report. Source: RBI

cards.title: SEBI issues three market-structure circulars on 5 Nov; no NBFC lending instrument
cards.summary: SEBI's 5 Nov circulars cover the accredited-investor framework, net settlement of funds for mutual-fund cash-market trades, and currency-derivatives exposure limits. None changes NBFC lending rules.

cards.title: Muthoot Microfin Q2 FY27: PAT ₹110.8 crore, NIM 12.5%, GNPA 3.38%
cards.summary: Beyond the headline PAT, Muthoot Microfin reported NIM up 50 bps QoQ to 12.5%, average cost of borrowing down to 9.93%, credit cost 2.6%, GNPA 3.38% (−123 bps YoY) and NNPA 1.05%. Non-JLG portfolio rose to 31% of GLP; CareEdge Global revised its outlook to Positive.
cards.impact: better subsidiary earnings and funding cost feed the consolidated Q2 story and the group funding narrative.

cards.title: CareEdge Global revises Muthoot Microfin outlook to Positive
cards.summary: Muthoot Microfin's Q2 release says CareEdge Global revised its outlook to Positive while reaffirming the BB- rating; CRISIL's earlier AA-/Stable long-term and A1+ CP ratings were restated in the same note. Source: NSE press release (Muthoot Microfin)
cards.impact: a Positive outlook at the MFI subsidiary is a group-credit data point, not a change to Muthoot Fincorp's own NCD ratings.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Friday: Auto finance & EV lending
cards.title: AMU Leasing's commercial-EV book reaches 14,000 customers across 10 states
cards.summary: AMU Leasing, an RBI-registered NBFC focused on commercial EVs, said it has about 14,000 customers across 10 states, with non-metro markets at 65% of disbursements, and plans to enter Rajasthan and Chhattisgarh. The portfolio covers e-2Ws, e-3Ws, passenger and commercial EVs plus battery solutions.
cards.impact: none direct. It shows specialist NBFCs still scaling EV books outside metros while gold lenders stay on collateralised products.

cards.title: Consolidation of Instructions Related to Priority Sector Lending – Drafts for Comments
cards.summary: RBI on 5 Nov placed five draft Priority Sector Lending Directions on its website — one each for commercial banks, small finance banks, local area banks, regional rural banks and urban co-operative banks — and invited comments by 26 Nov 2026. The drafts consolidate existing PSL targets and classification rules; ETBFSI reports they retain the overall PSL targets and the 5% cap on eligible bank lending through NBFCs for on-lending.
cards.impact: no new NBFC Direction today, but the retained 5% on-lending cap is the ceiling that shapes how much PSL-eligible bank money can reach gold and other NBFC books through the on-lending channel.
